title: Account Executive
description:
Location: Horsham (Office-Based Free onsite parking & near train station)

Career Path: Direct progression to Account Management & Sales

Ready to launch your commercial career?

At Global 4, we don t just offer a job; we offer a launchpad. If you are a confident communicator with a commercial "spark" and a desire to build a career in sales or account management, this is where your journey begins.

As a Account Executive / Client Support Specialist, you will be the heartbeat of our customer relationships. This isn't just about answering inbound queries it s a dynamic, commercial role where you will take ownership of a client portfolio, manage renewals, and uncover opportunities to grow revenue.

The Role

You will bridge the gap between world-class customer support and savvy sales. Working closely with our seasoned Account Managers, you will act as a trusted point of contact, ensuring our customers always have the right technology solutions at the right time.

This role is purpose-built for progression. We will teach you the ropes of consultative selling, product knowledge, and pipeline management, setting you up for a future promotion into a full Account Management or Sales role.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Account Development
- Be the Go-To Contact: Manage a portfolio of customers, handling both inbound enquiries and proactive outbound check-ins.
- Build Relationships: Welcome new clients to Global 4, review their services, and align their needs with our tailored solutions.
- Deliver Excellence: Handle service discussions confidently while maintaining a sharp commercial mindset.

Revenue, Renewals & Growth
- Protect & Grow: Take ownership of contract renewals to safeguard existing revenue while ensuring a seamless customer experience.
- Spot Opportunities: Identify and progress natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell our wider range of products and services.
- Drive the Pipeline: Accurately quote, close opportunities, and feed larger, complex leads to the senior Account Management team.

Pipeline Management & Progression
- Master the Process: Keep a structured, up-to-date pipeline of renewals and upgrades, ensuring all activities are accurately logged in the CRM.
- Level Up Your Knowledge: Learn the ins and outs of our multi-product portfolio, including connectivity, telephony, mobile, and IT services.
- Evolve Your Skills: Develop confidence in objection handling and consultative sales, positioning yourself for your next big career step.

What We re Looking For

We hire for attitude and train for skill. Previous experience in a customer-facing or sales support role is a bonus, but absolutely not essential full training is provided!
- The Ambition: A genuine, burning desire to build a long-term career in sales or account management.
- The Communicator: You are articulate, confident over the phone, and love engaging with people.
- The Commercial Mindset: You take pride in taking ownership of revenue, outcomes, and targets.
- The Organiser: Strong organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple customer conversations and follow up proactively.
- The Attitude: Positive, eager to learn, and ready to thrive in a bustling office environment.

Why Join Global 4?

We are a family-run company that actually acts like one. We ve created an energetic, supportive environment where your hard work is celebrated and rewarded.

The Perks:
- Generous Leave: 33 days holiday (inc. bank holidays), a Buy & Sell scheme, plus up to 5 extra days rewarded for length of service.
- Tech Discounts: 50% off our Broadband & Utility packages (completely FREE after two years!).
- Health & Security: Death in service benefit, pension scheme, and eye care vouchers.
- Office Culture: Complimentary fresh fruit, bottomless tea/coffee, and the legendary "Friday Fridge."
- Rewards: Company lunches, fun team incentives, and our "Kudos" Employee Recognition Scheme.
- Giving Back: Paid Charity leave and a £250 "Bright Ideas" scheme.

Global 4 is proud to be an Equal Opportunities and Living Wage Foundation employer. We offer a fantastic working environment with numerous charity events, team-building days, and excellent training opportunities.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Horsham £25,000-£27,000
Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm On-site parking

Do you have some initial Accounts/Finance experience and feel ready to broaden your knowledge, take on more responsibility and continue developing your career?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established business in Horsham, working closely with the Financial Controller in a busy and varied role offering exposure across a broad range of accounting responsibilities.

You'll get involved in much more than day-to-day transactional finance, making this a great next step for someone keen to learn, develop and build their experience.

What you'll be doing
- Assisting with monthly management information and management accounts
- Preparing accruals, prepayments and journals
- Bank and balance sheet reconciliations
- Investigating and reporting on variances
- Supporting the year-end audit
- Purchase and sales ledger
- Processing supplier payments and customer invoices
- Credit control and employee expenses
- Supporting the Financial Controller with wider projects

About you

You'll have some practical experience within an Accounts environment and be keen to continue developing professionally. You may already be studying towards AAT, CIMA, ACCA or ACA, or looking for a role that will support your longer-term accounting career.

You'll be organised, accurate and confident with Excel, with a positive approach and willingness to learn.

What's on offer
- £25,000-£27,000
- Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm with an hour for lunch
- On-site parking
- Study support available following successful completion of probation
- Broad exposure and plenty of opportunity to learn and develop

If you're looking for your next Accounts role and want an opportunity where you can broaden your experience and continue progressing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today for immediate consideration.

If you are an experienced administrator with great communication skills and are available immediately, we would love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper
company: Bennett and Game Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Bookkeeper
Location: Horsham, (fully remote role) -First 2 weeks are in office
Package: 28,000 - 32,000 , fully remote job, excellent culture, holiday & pension
Working hours: Full time, standard hours of 9am-5pm

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Bookkeeper, within a growing accountancy practice based in Horsham. This practice boast an excellent culture, and offer fantastic flexibility, with a fully remote model. They are seeking a bookkeeper who is detail oriented and experienced in working with clients, establishing strong relationships, and delivering a consistent service

This practice currently has 15 members of staff and are looking to double this within the coming years. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper to further their career, within an exciting practice

Bookkeeper Job Responsibilities
- Process purchase and sales invoices, maintaining accurate financial records within Xero and QuickBooks Online.
- Manage client inboxes, financial documentation, and respond promptly to client, supplier, and internal queries.
- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Prepare supplier payment schedules and support effective cash flow management for clients.
- Administer Dext/Receipt Bank, process expenses, and ensure compliance with HMRC guidelines.
- Assist with payroll processing, including timesheets, pension administration, and new starter/leaver documentation.
- Support VAT returns, management accounts preparation, and year-end audit requirements while ensuring VAT compliance.
- Monitor debtor reports, chase outstanding payments, and help clients improve credit control processes.

Bookkeeper Job Requirements
- Previous Bookkeeping experience within practice is preferred
- AAT Level 2-3 is ideal but not essential
- Should have a strong working knowledge of VAT rules, and an understanding of payroll processes
- Confident IT skills including Xero, QBO, Receipt Bank, and Dext, are preferable
- Excellent organisation, interpersonal, and communication skills

Bookkeeper Salary & Benefits
- Paying from 28,000 - 32,000 depending on experience
- Fully remote model is available - the team gets together once a quarter within the Horsham office. First 2 weeks are in office
- 20 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Company pension and sick pay contribution
- Private medical healthcare
- And more

Bennett and Game Recruitment are a multi-disciplined technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex operating across the UK with specialist teams covering a range of industries.
We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy, and in accordance with GDPR by applying you are granting us consent to process your data, contact you about the services we offer, and submit your CV for the role you have applied for.
